root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The same width:100% resolves to very different sizes depending on the containing pane (235px candidate vs 738px timeline)

development_approach.strategy: Scoped CSS override under .slot-selected for thumbnail sizing + flex layout; JS onload guard in renderCover() for naturalWidth check. Minimal blast radius — only 3 CSS blocks and 1 JS block touched.
development_approach.validation_approach: QA: Playwright at 1440x900 desktop — measure computed style of img.card-photo in .slot-selected (height <= 100px, display on parent = flex); measure candidate card img (aspect-ratio still 16/9); verify Playwright page shows #trip-cover hidden for Kunming day (naturalWidth 500 < 800)

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex provided exact CSS for Q1 (flex row with 80px thumbnail scoped under .slot-selected, with :not(.card-photo) flex:1 rule for text children) and exact JS for Q2 (onload property assignment before img.src, naturalWidth check hides-or-shows). Q3 OBSERVATION_ONLY: do not add object-position:top; center crop is better for wide 21/9 city skyline crops.

findings.issue: Q1: .slot-selected needs display:flex + scoped .card-photo override (80x80px, aspect-ratio:auto) + text children flex:1
findings.proposed_fix: .slot-selected { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; ... } .slot-selected .card-photo { flex:0 0 80px; width:80px; height:80px; aspect-ratio:auto; object-fit:cover; } .slot-selected > :not(.card-photo) { flex:1; min-width:0; }
findings.rationale: Exact proposed CSS incorporated into Technical Hints. BA refined: scoped override must follow base .card-photo in cascade order (Codex flagged this).

findings.issue: Q2: onload must be assigned as property before img.src; naturalWidth < 800 hides element; else branch nulls onload
findings.proposed_fix: img.onload = () => { if (img.naturalWidth < 800) { img.hidden=true; img.removeAttribute('src'); } }; img.hidden=false; img.src=url;
findings.rationale: Incorporated. BA refined the hidden-until-loaded pattern: img.hidden stays true until onload passes naturalWidth >= 800 check (prevents flicker of loading state). Codex original set img.hidden=false before onload fires; BA spec reverses to img.hidden=true until check passes.

findings.issue: Q3: object-position:top would over-emphasize sky in wide 21/9 crops; center crop is better default for city skylines
findings.rationale: Accepted — no CSS change for object-position. Already excluded from scope per dispatch.

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Q1 CSS applied verbatim with cascade-order note added. Q2 JS applied with BA refinement: img.hidden=true before src set (hidden-until-loaded pattern). Q3 observation logged; no action.
